subheading: CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE NECROTIZING ULCERATIVE GINGIVITIS
subheading_corrected: CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE NECROTIZING ULCERATIVE GINGIVITIS
text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE NECROTIZING ULCERATIVE GINGIVITIS
- Crater ulcers starting at the tips of the interdental papillae
- Ulcers spread along gingival margins
- Gingival soreness and bleeding
- Foul breath
- Metallic taste
- Increased salivation
- Cervical lymphadenopathy and fever in advanced cases
